questions.skill: Use similar triangles to explain slope and derive y = mx and y = mx + b
questions.prompt: Two slope triangles are drawn under the line. Explain why they give the same slope.
questions.prompt_markup: Two slope triangles are drawn under the line. Explain why they give the same slope.
questions.correct_answer: The triangles are similar (they have the same angles), so their rise-to-run ratios are equal: 2/3 = 2/3.
